findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: moltguard_feed, mt_get_badge · Private data: moltrust_register, moltrust_verify, moltrust_credential, moltrust_deposit_info, moltrust_claim_deposit, moltrust_stats, moltguard_score, moltguard_detail, moltguard_sybil, moltguard_credential_issue, moltguard_credential_verify, mt_shopping_verify, mt_shopping_issue_vc, mt_travel_issue_vc, mt_skill_verify, mt_skill_issue_vc, mt_prediction_link, mt_prediction_wallet, mt_salesguard_verify, mt_salesguard_register, mt_create_interaction_proof, mt_endorse_agent, mt_get_trust_score, mt_issue_music_credential, mt_verify_music_credential, mt_get_track_provenance, moltproof_verify · Public sink: moltrust_rate, moltrust_claim_deposit, mt_salesguard_register.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: moltguard_feed, mt_get_badge · Private data: moltrust_register, moltrust_verify, moltrust_credential, moltrust_deposit_info, moltrust_claim_deposit, moltrust_stats, moltguard_score, moltguard_detail, moltguard_sybil, moltguard_credential_issue, moltguard_credential_verify, mt_shopping_verify, mt_shopping_issue_vc, mt_travel_issue_vc, mt_skill_verify, mt_skill_issue_vc, mt_prediction_link, mt_prediction_wallet, mt_salesguard_verify, mt_salesguard_register, mt_create_interaction_proof, mt_endorse_agent, mt_get_trust_score, mt_issue_music_credential, mt_verify_music_credential, mt_get_track_provenance, moltproof_verify · Public sink: moltrust_rate, moltrust_claim_deposit, mt_salesguard_register

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
